A fast, simple and powerful PDF reader
Private. Your data stay on your device.
No ads. No tracking. No accounts.
All your PDFs in one place
Continue right where you left off
Browse your folders like a file manager
Search every PDF on your device
Dark mode for the pages themselves
Text mode with your own typography
Choose your toolbar and shortcut bar actions
Horizontal, vertical or right to left reading
Brightness, zoom lock and fullscreen controls
Dynamic colors that match your device
A correctness and stability release. New reading options, much safer saving, and a long list of fixes across the whole app.
The largest update so far. A new home screen, annotation tools, and a rework of nearly every part of the app.
Show exactly one page at a time, no matter how big the window is. Part of the new Reading Mode setting.
Fit pages by width, by height, or show the whole page.
Pick how long the fullscreen controls stay on screen before hiding.
The theme button stays visible while the PDF theme follows the system, and lets you pick a theme on the spot.
Searching now happens inside the reader, with the document still in view.
Next and previous wrap at both ends, and Jump Back returns you to where you were.
Every save is verified, a failed save keeps a rescue copy, and saved files no longer grow with each save.
A file shared from another app asks before a copy is kept. Choose to always keep copies or to be asked each time.
Documents are identified more reliably, so two similar files never share reading history.
Dozens of fixes across search, gestures, backups, rotation, and right to left reading.
All 15 languages cover every new setting and dialog.
Tabs, statuses, scanning, search and stats
Recent, Library and Folders. Swipe between them; the app remembers the tab you were on.
The Recent tab starts with a Continue Reading row for the books you are in the middle of, above your full reading history.
Give any book a status: To Read, Reading, On Hold, Completed or Abandoned.\nFilter the Library with the status chips at the top.
Long press a book to start selecting, then change the status of many books at once.
Mark books as favorites and filter for them with the Favorites chip.
Switch between a cover grid and a list.\nChange the grid size and the sort order from the menu button in the top bar.

The three dots button on every book offers:
Properties and reading progress.
Reading status and favorite.
Hiding it from the library.
Renaming the file on disk.
Deleting it from the device.

The Folders tab browses your device like a file manager:
Enter folders and jump back with the breadcrumbs.
See each folder's PDF count.
Switch to a flat view listing all PDFs at once.
SD cards are included.
The home search covers your whole device.\nLibrary matches are listed first, PDFs you never opened after them.
Scan the whole device or only folders you pick.\nChange it any time under Scan locations in the home menu.\nThe library then keeps itself up to date automatically.
Hide a book to remove it from the library without touching the file.\nHidden books remain listed in the Reading History screen.

Open Library Stats from the home menu. It shows:
Storage used by your PDFs.
Pages read and favorites.
A count for every reading status.
Prefer the old behavior? Disable Home Library in the Advanced settings makes the app open the system file picker directly on launch.
Modes, scrolling, auto scroll and fullscreen

One Reading Mode setting chooses Continuous, Horizontal, Single Page, or Dual Page.\nRight to left documents are detected and read right to left.\nThe Reading Direction action overrides the direction per document.
Fit pages by width, by height, or show the whole page.\nSingle Page Mode shows exactly one page regardless of the window size.
Show pages side by side like a book spread while scrolling vertically.\nFirst Page Alone keeps the cover on its own.\nThe Dual Page Mode quick action flips it without losing your position.
Page Snap aligns the view to the nearest page after scrolling.\nPage Fling turns exactly one page per quick swipe.
Scroll vertically without sideways drift; the view only moves sideways on a clearly horizontal swipe.
Hands free reading with adjustable speed, the same real speed on every device.\nPauses while you touch the page.\nEach document remembers its own speed.

Render the pages themselves in dark mode, always or following the system.\nThe Toggle PDF Theme action switches instantly while reading.\nWhile following the system, the button opens a small dialog to pick a theme.
Crop the empty margins of every page for a bigger text area.\nThe file is not modified.\nAlways Hide Page Margins applies it to every document.

Extracts the text and reflows it into clean paragraphs with detected headings.\nFont size, colors, line length and paragraph joining are configurable.\nOpen in Text Mode by Default makes it the standard view.
Distraction free, edge to edge reading with an overlay of quick buttons including a brightness slider and Zoom Lock.\nOpen in Fullscreen switches to it automatically.
A small card with the time, page number and reading percentage shows while scrolling and in fullscreen.\nChoose exactly what it displays in the settings.
Tap the scroll handle to jump to any page.\nThe handle can also show the page count, and the toolbar the page number.
The volume buttons turn pages.\nThe back and forward buttons of a connected mouse work too.
Prevent the screen from sleeping while reading.
Start every PDF from page 1 while your reading position is still saved in the background.
Open a PDF straight from a URL with the Online PDF action.
High Quality Rendering, Smooth Edges and Maximum Zoom are adjustable for sharper pages or lighter memory use.
Selection, highlights, notes, signature and forms

Long press any word to select it, then drag the handles.\nA card offers Copy and Search web, and Search web becomes Open Link when the selection contains a link.\nSelection can be turned off in the settings.
Pick a color from the strip to turn the selection into a real PDF highlight annotation that other readers show too.\nThe six colors of the strip are yours to choose in the Highlighting settings.
Attach a note to any highlight. Tap the highlight later to read or edit it.
Tap an existing highlight to select it instantly, change its color, edit its note or remove it.

Two pages list every highlight and note in the document with its chapter:
Search them or filter by color.
Sort by date or position.
Export them as a text file.
Tap one to jump to its page.
Selecting text that exactly matches a highlight already in the file shows its actions instead of creating a duplicate.
Draw your signature once with Add Signature, then place, move and resize it on any page.\nStored as sharp vector strokes and remembered for the next document.\nBlack, blue, red and green ink.
Tap text fields and checkboxes in PDF forms to fill them in.
Save your changes into the file itself or as a new copy.\nThe app writes directly to the file whenever it can and only asks you to locate it when it truly cannot.
Unsaved highlights are journaled continuously.\nIf the app is killed, restore or discard them the next time the document opens.
Contents, bookmarks, history, links and search

Browse the outline with expand and collapse all.\nThe path to the chapter you are reading is highlighted, and the locate button scrolls straight to it.\nExpansion and scroll position are kept while you read.

Bookmark any page with the star.
Rename them and reorder them freely.
Each shows the chapter it belongs to.
Deleting asks for confirmation.
Every jump is recorded; go back and forward like in a browser.\nThe Navigation History page shows the full trail in both directions.
Links inside the PDF work, and after following one a button returns you to the exact spot you came from.\nLinks in the File lists every link in the document.

Results stream in while the document is scanned and show their surrounding text.\nOpening a match centers and zooms it, and a button returns you to the results where you left them.\nAccented letters can be matched to plain ones.
Screenshot, print, share, extract and more
Save the current view as an image with the Screenshot action.
Print the PDF through Android printing, including downloaded files.
Send the file to any app with Share File.
Page Text shows the full text of the current page for selecting and copying.
Title, author, page count and size, page dimensions, embedded fonts, and creation and modification dates.
Re-opens the file in place, useful when another app has changed it.
Lock or rotate the screen orientation from the reader.\nDefault to Landscape always reads sideways.
Open a different file or an online URL without leaving the reader.
Password protected files ask for the password once.\nYou can let the app remember it.
No ads, no tracking, no accounts.\nThe network is used only to open online PDFs you request and to send crash reports only if you explicitly approve.

Open a document and nothing is recorded: no history, no position, no password, no per document settings.\nReach it from the reader menu, a long press on the home open button, a book\'s options, or the settings.

A file shared from another app can be kept as a private copy so it opens reliably later.\nChoose between always keeping a copy and being asked each time.\nVery large files and low storage always ask first.
One switch in History and Privacy stops all history saving everywhere, including Text Mode.
Lists every remembered document, including hidden ones, with last opened date and progress.\nDelete entries one by one or clear everything.

Separate, confirmed actions clear:
Reading history and positions.
Saved passwords.
All bookmarks.
Crash recovery data and the stored signature.
Let the app remember the password of a protected PDF so it opens directly next time.\nClear them all with one action.
Export Settings & History writes a backup file with the sections you choose: settings, reading history, and optionally saved passwords.\nImport it on any device.
Pick a Backup Folder and the app exports your settings and reading history there every day.\nPasswords are never included automatically.
Themes, buttons and per document memory
Light, dark or follow the system, with dynamic colors taken from your device on Android 12 and newer.
Pick the two actions that sit in the reader toolbar with Primary and Secondary Toolbar Button.\nAny action can go there, from Screenshot to Incognito.
An optional second bar under the toolbar.\nChoose and order its actions with Shortcut Bar Actions.
Choose which buttons the fullscreen overlay shows.\nHide their labels if you prefer icons only.\nControls Hide Delay picks how long they stay before hiding.

Remembered separately for every document:
Reading position and zoom.
Reading direction and hidden margins.
Auto scroll speed.
Text Mode options.
The interface is available in 15 languages.

This backup contains reading history. Importing it wipes the settings, reading history, and bookmarks on this device and replaces them with the backup's data. A snapshot of the current data is saved first and can be brought back from the backup settings page. Restored entries link up with their files again when you open them or when the library scan finds them.

It also deletes unsaved highlight recovery data and the stored signature. Those are not part of a backup, so the snapshot cannot bring them back. Save any highlights into their files first.

The app restarts when the import finishes.
